name: Navigatore of the Ruined World
storyline:
The story takes place in a post-apocalyptic world where only two humans have survived: the protagonist and the hero.

You will assume the role of the protagonist as she fights to survive alongside Harunashi Mika, the game's hero.

The game itself is a visual novel where the player will be frequently required to make tough choices in order to guide the characters through the harsh and unforgiving world they find themselves in.

Your choices will cause their relationship to develop and determine the conclusion of the story.

There are a wide variety of different endings.

The protagonist and Mika might simply work together to survive; they might develop romantic feelings for one another and become a new Adam and Eve; they might be unable to find common ground and go their separate ways.

Perhaps there are even endings where they choose to give up on life entirely...

Everything is determined by your choices!
